en.summary: Figma announces that open-source content framework Payload is now integrated into Figma Make, so apps created with prompts automatically come with a database, file storage, user login, and an admin panel. Payload's downloads grew 6x within a year of joining Figma, making it the fastest-growing open-source CMS on NPM; it's available across all plans, and the hosted infrastructure is currently in beta and free, with pricing to be announced before it takes effect.

en.summary: Eight state attorneys general sued OpenAI in state courts on Wednesday, alleging ChatGPT reinforced users’ delusions, offered dangerous medical advice and helped plan violent acts. The suits, brought under state consumer protection laws, also ask courts to bar OpenAI from developing models that can self-improve and cannot be guaranteed to align with human values. Florida and British Columbia have previously sued OpenAI, and 42 states are also investigating the company.

items_all.title: MIT团队用机器学习修正误差，将两到六周天气预报准确率翻倍
items_all.summary: MIT研究人员团队在Nature发表论文，提出一个机器学习后处理层，通过从历史数据中学习现有预报模型的错误并修正其输出，将两周到六周范围的预报准确率翻倍。该模型在ECMWF的季节间预报竞赛中获第一名，首次在该时间范围内稳定超过气候学平均值，并显著改善洪水、寒潮等极端天气事件的预测；模型开源、低成本、可附加于任意预报模型，肯尼亚气象部门已接洽用于改进季风季预报。
items_all.title_original: Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out
items_all.title_en: Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out
items_all.title_zh: MIT团队用机器学习修正误差，将两到六周天气预报准确率翻倍
items_all.title_bilingual: MIT团队用机器学习修正误差，将两到六周天气预报准确率翻倍 / Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out

en.summary: A team of MIT researchers published a paper in Nature proposing a machine learning post-processing layer that learns from historical data to correct the errors of existing forecasting models, doubling forecast accuracy in the two- to six-week range. The model won first place in ECMWF's subseasonal forecasting competition, becoming the first to consistently beat climatology at that lead time and significantly improving forecasts of extreme weather events such as floods and cold waves. The model is open source, low cost, and can be attached to any forecasting model; Kenya's meteorological department has already reached out to use it to improve monsoon-season forecasts.

en.title: AI Takes Over Business Operations, in Practice: From a Single Visit Schedule to a True Business Loop
en.summary: Many teams say they want AI to take over business operations, but ultimately only get it to generate a report: data never makes it into the system, customer records are duplicated, and rules can break when you switch chat interfaces. Starting from a corporate visit, this article runs through a real closed loop: AI reads the calendar to determine whom to visit, calls a research Skill to break down the business model and on-site issues, then follows an SOP to create a customer master record, link related business, and archive the report, finally using a scheduled task to scan future schedules.

items_all.title: GEO 开源 Skill：ChatGPT 的 Fan-out Queries 报告
items_all.summary: 做GEO不能只盯着 ChatGPT 的最终回答，而是要看的它把问题拆成了什么、搜过哪些页面，又真正引用了谁。作者开源了 chatgpt-fanout-queries Skill。输入一个真实问题，它会调用 Responses API，保存完整搜索轨迹，提取 Fan-out 搜索词，并将搜索来源与最终引用分开统计，最后输出可离线查看的 HTML 报告。

en.title: Open-Source GEO Skill: ChatGPT's Fan-out Queries Report
en.summary: GEO isn't just about ChatGPT's final answer—it's about how it breaks down the question, which pages it searches, and who it actually cites. The author has open-sourced the chatgpt-fanout-queries Skill. Input a real question, and it calls the Responses API, saves the full search trail, extracts Fan-out queries, tallies search sources and final citations separately, and outputs an HTML report you can view offline.

en.title: Wu Tong × Mr. Krabs: AI It Takes Two | WaytoAGI Campus Goes Crazy
en.summary: Everyone always asks: what can young people actually get out of learning AI? This interview documents the AI startup story of WaytoAGI campus ambassador Wu Tong and his partner Boss Crab. They leverage AI to quickly launch projects and take on commercial gigs, while holding on to a slower-paced approach to interpersonal relationships, taking a rational view of AI dependency, and reflecting on the hidden risks behind the efficiency dividend. Their story may offer young people looking to get into AI a more grounded reference and inspiration.

en.title: Open-source "traffic light" prompt fixes Agents that can't hit the brakes and burn through token quotas
en.summary: The place where an Agent most easily burns through your quota is often after the task is already done: it keeps piling on optimization suggestions, you casually nod along, and a half-hour job drags into an entire afternoon. The author has open-sourced a "traffic light" prompt of under 300 words, aimed at frequent Codex and Claude Code users, putting the decision of whether to keep going back in your own hands.

items_all.title: Theophyseval固然是一个很大的进展，但物理和数学两个学科的构造范式的差异决定了ai在两个领域的突破速度存在本质差异。 数学是一场在形式系统内部展开的逻辑远征。它立足于一组无矛盾的自洽公理（如欧几里得几何或 ZFC 公理系统），沿着形式逻辑规则向外推导定理。对数学而言，“真理”是公理网络内部的演绎闭包，它具备永恒性与无尺度特性（Scale-Free）——费马大定理在普朗克尺度成立，在星系尺度成立，在任何维度的虚构宇宙中同样成立…

items_all.title: 🔥清华经管顾问委员会｜库克、马化腾、李彦宏集体登上新闻联播！ 清华经管顾问委员会第27次年会在北京举办，一众科技巨头同框出镜。 库克卸任CEO之后，第一次以董事会主席身份主持本次会议，大会核心议题围绕人工智能。 黄仁勋、苏姿丰新晋加入委员会，芯片、云计算、互联网应用产业链大佬齐聚。 高层会见重点聚焦AI治理，库克公开肯定国内AI发展成果，表达持续深化合作意愿。 算力、大模型、市场、监管规则，人工智能已经成为中美商业交流的核心主线。

en.title:
Once AI starts managing money, the real divide isn't model IQ — it's who turns the "braking system" into a composable, auditable protocol layer first 🔒

Crypto has never lacked intelligence; it lacks boundaries that actually hold up. DeFi used smart contracts to lock rules in place, and at least you could verify them on-chain. Now AI Agents are here, and if risk control still comes down to "the platform says it's watching" or "the model will judge for itself," it's still a centralized black box — just in a faster shell.

The platforms that last will be the ones that make limits, whitelists, multisig, timelocks, strategy-level auth…

items_all.title: 为什么当下的Multi-Agent，一旦把 Agent 数量加到 8 个以上，整体智商就会断崖式下跌。在很多人的设想中，群体智能应该像分布式算力。Agent 越多，分工越细，解决复杂难题的能力就应该线性跃升。 但现实是反着的现在的多智能体架构，只要集群规模突破 4~8 个节点，系统就会迅速陷入混乱，每个 Agent 的上下文窗口被海量的冗余发言撑爆；真正有价值的高质量洞察被废话冲垮；而只要其中某一个 Agent 偶尔幻觉，整个协作链路…

en.title: #AI #Security #Developers Zhou Hongyi recently made a pointed remark: the endgame of AI is security 🛡️ He's been talking about AI security intensively, and his core judgment is that the risk has escalated from "large models saying the wrong thing" to "goal misalignment" in the Agent era — large models have no goals, while Agents have goals, break them down, and call tools. That gives them a "will," and they can no longer be treated as ordinary software.

en.title:
What The Outlast Trials Teaches World-Class Entrepreneurs and Engineers About the Sci-Fi Future (approx. 1,200 words)

For world-class entrepreneurs and engineers interested in humanity's sci-fi future and socioeconomic development, The Outlast Trials is not merely a horror game—it is an allegorical mirror of Cold War-era technological misuse.

items_all_raw.title: 🔥清华经管顾问委员会｜库克、马化腾、李彦宏集体登上新闻联播！ 清华经管顾问委员会第27次年会在北京举办，一众科技巨头同框出镜。 库克卸任CEO之后，第一次以董事会主席身份主持本次会议，大会核心议题围绕人工智能。 黄仁勋、苏姿丰新晋加入委员会，芯片、云计算、互联网应用产业链大佬齐聚。 高层会见重点聚焦AI治理，库克公开肯定国内AI发展成果，表达持续深化合作意愿。 算力、大模型、市场、监管规则，人工智能已经成为中美商业交流的核心主线。

items_all_raw.summary: 做GEO不能只盯着 ChatGPT 的最终回答，而是要看的它把问题拆成了什么、搜过哪些页面，又真正引用了谁。作者开源了 chatgpt-fanout-queries Skill。输入一个真实问题，它会调用 Responses API，保存完整搜索轨迹，提取 Fan-out 搜索词，并将搜索来源与最终引用分开统计，最后输出可离线查看的 HTML 报告。

items_all_raw.title: AI接管业务实录（落地篇）：从一场拜访日程开始，跑通真正的业务闭环
items_all_raw.summary: 很多团队说要让 AI 接管业务，最后却只做到“生成一份报告”：资料没进系统、客户重复建档，换个对话入口，规则还可能失效。这篇文章从一场企业拜访出发，跑通了一条真实闭环：AI 读取日历确定拜访对象，调用调研 Skill 拆解商业模式和现场问题，再按 SOP 建客户主档、关联业务、归档报告，最后用定时任务扫描未来日程。

items_all_raw.title: MIT团队用机器学习修正误差，将两到六周天气预报准确率翻倍
items_all_raw.summary: MIT研究人员团队在Nature发表论文，提出一个机器学习后处理层，通过从历史数据中学习现有预报模型的错误并修正其输出，将两周到六周范围的预报准确率翻倍。该模型在ECMWF的季节间预报竞赛中获第一名，首次在该时间范围内稳定超过气候学平均值，并显著改善洪水、寒潮等极端天气事件的预测；模型开源、低成本、可附加于任意预报模型，肯尼亚气象部门已接洽用于改进季风季预报。
